yaml.title: Practical guides
yaml.subtitle: Disseminating the results of THEILUMINA and explaining Theil indices in detail

markdown.markdown:
::: {.guide-logo} ![](images/brand/theilumina_logo_en.png){fig-alt="THEILUMINA logo"} ::: This section gathers **practical guides** that disseminate the results of the project and explain Theil indices in detail: what they measure, how to **estimate** them, how to **decompose** them into inequality between and within groups, and how to make **inferences** about them (bias, standard errors and confidence intervals). Each guide includes worked examples with R code, **recommendations and good-practice advice**, and the most common pitfalls. The guides are written for the groups that produce, publish or use inequality indicators: ::: {.audience} Statistical offices (INE, regional institutes) International institutions (Eurostat, World Bank, OECD) Inequality observatories Public administrations and policy makers Researchers and students Society at large ::: New guides will be added as the project produces results, for example on bias correction (WP1), confidence intervals (WP2), the fast jackknife (WP3) and the **theil** R package (WP4). ::: {.guide-card} ### A practical guide to Theil indices in R

November 2026 · English and Spanish · Level: introductory–intermediate

How to compute $T_0$ and $T_1$ with base R and current CRAN packages (`ineq`, `dineq`, `IC2`, `convey`, `inequality`), how to decompose them between and within groups (with examples by region and by sex), and how to estimate their bias and standard error with the jackknife and the bootstrap. [Read in English](guides/theil-indices-r.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm} [Leer en español](guides/indices-theil-r-es.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm} ::: ::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"} Would you like a guide on a specific topic, or to use these guides in a course or a statistical office? [Contact us](contact.qmd). :::
